title: Polymarket Halted International Trading After Hackers Drained Accounts
gist: Polymarket stopped trading on its crypto-based international platform for several hours after a breach at a UK-based third-party vendor drained some traders' wallets. Bubblemaps estimates about 700 users were hit and about $2.7 million stolen, and Polymarket says it will refund them. It is the second breach in 2026, after a June incident that cost traders over $2 million, and it comes for a company valued at $21 billion following a $1 billion raise led by 1789 Capital.

insights.claim: A UK-based third-party vendor was breached, not Polymarket's website itself, and some traders' wallets on the flagship international platform were drained. Trading was paused for several hours and UK law enforcement was notified.
insights.speaker: Kate Knibbs
insights.so_what: Third-party vendor risk is an attack surface for crypto platforms, and outages hurt trust in the platform.
